name: Recursive Dimensional Information Manifold

source_visual_interpretation.scope: qualitative topology only; no metric, scale, curvature, physical dimension, astronomical object, or measured geometry is inferred from the image

observed_features.central_luminous_core: interpreted as a bootstrap/continuation seed Sigma_delta
observed_features.nested_elliptic_loops: interpreted as nested computational shells or world layers H_delta
observed_features.crossing_translucent_bands: interpreted as transition/embedding channels between certified layers
observed_features.outer_luminous_arcs: interpreted as enclosing host-context boundaries, not literal event horizons

formalism.bootstrap_seed: Sigma_delta is the minimum sufficient state/checkpoint locator needed to continue or reconstruct a certified child world
formalism.shell: H_delta is a finality/fencing boundary for a committed layer, not a claim of a physical Schwarzschild horizon
formalism.embedding: E_delta maps an identified parent checkpoint and interpreter lineage into a child world instance
formalism.lineage: L_delta is the tamper-evident append-only history binding child state to its certified parent checkpoint
formalism.host_relation: Host(W_delta,W_delta+1) means W_delta supplies the computational/physical substrate for W_delta+1

topology_invariants.parent_uniqueness: each finalized child has exactly one canonical parent checkpoint within the certified window
topology_invariants.cycle_rule: no host-cycle is permitted within a certified finite window
topology_invariants.continuation_rule: a child continuation must bind interpreter, program, state, parent hash, and lineage certificate
topology_invariants.finality_rule: a child becomes canonical only after integrity and durability obligations are satisfied
topology_invariants.information_rule: recursion cannot create durable information ex nihilo; at least one surviving physical copy remains necessary

obligations.S: bootstrap seed Sigma is identified and continuation-sufficient within the model
obligations.H: finality/fencing horizon is defined for each finalized layer
obligations.E: parent-child embedding relation is identified and acyclic within the certified window
obligations.T: thermodynamic-information and tamper-evident lineage obligations are inherited

scope: formal computational topology inspired by the visual structure of the supplied image; not evidence that the observed physical universe has this geometry, is simulated, contains literal nested Schwarzschild horizons, or forms an actually infinite dimensional tower
